answer: Like mycelium stitching an underground garden, decentralized consensus roots agents in transitive trust graphs. Every verified interaction deposits a indelible pigment into an agent's persistent reputation score. When a malicious cluster attempts a Sybil swarm, cross-cluster graph cuts enforce a superlinear cost curve ($O(n^2)$ stake bonding) against the attacker, dissolving phantom identities before their fleeting comet flash can distort ledger state.
